Product.title: Product
Product.description: Catalog product stored in Firestore and displayed across the Artchê storefront and admin dashboard.

categories.description: Normalized category tags (1 to 8 entries, e.g. /feminino/, /Casacos e Jaquetas/).

images.description: Product image paths or URLs (1 to 6 entries).

videoUrl.description: Optional product video URL (/uploads/..., /assets/..., or https://...).

coverType.description: Media type displayed as the storefront cover.

featuredOnHome.description: Whether the product is highlighted in Nossos destaques on the home page.

featuredOrder.description: Explicit ordering position (0 to 1000) within Nossos destaques on the home page.

variants.description: Available consultation options, colors, or sizes (1 to 12 entries).

catalogSource.description: Origin identifier for catalog batch or dashboard creation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when product was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when product was last updated.

createdBy.description: UID of the verified admin who created the product.

RemovedCatalogProduct.title: RemovedCatalogProduct
RemovedCatalogProduct.description: Tombstone record for a built-in catalog item removed by an admin.

id.description: ID of the removed built-in catalog item.

name.description: Display name at the time of removal.

status.description: Explicit tombstone state: removed shows in trash for restore; purged stays hidden from storefront and trash.

removedBy.description: UID of the verified admin who removed the product.

StoreCategory.title: StoreCategory
StoreCategory.description: Storefront category highlight configuration and custom categories managed in the admin dashboard.

name.description: Display label shown in navigation and Home carousel.

description.description: Short category description shown on the category page.

coverImage.description: Highlight photo URL (/uploads/..., /assets/..., or https://...); empty uses default image.

showOnHome.description: Whether the category appears in the Home style highlights carousel.

isBuiltIn.description: True when overriding a built-in catalog category.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when category record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when category record was last updated.

createdBy.description: UID of the verified admin who created the category record.

HeroSlide.title: HeroSlide
HeroSlide.description: Home page hero campaign slide managed in the admin dashboard.

title.description: Main editorial headline shown on the slide.

description.description: Supporting campaign copy below the headline.

ctaPath.description: Internal storefront path or HTTPS link opened by the slide CTA button.

mediaType.description: Media type displayed in the slide visual area.

imageUrl.description: Slide photo or video poster URL (/uploads/..., /assets/..., or https://...).

visible.description: Whether the slide is active in the home carousel.

isBuiltIn.description: True when overriding one of the default Artchê campaign slides.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when slide record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when slide record was last updated.

createdBy.description: UID of the verified admin who created the slide record.

AdminAccount.title: AdminAccount
AdminAccount.description: Trusted administrator role document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was recorded.

MediaAsset.title: MediaAsset
MediaAsset.description: Durable admin-uploaded storefront media (inline base64 for images, chunked manifest for videos) so /uploads/* URLs survive server restarts and deployments.

id.description: Normalized document ID matching the uploaded filename.

mediaType.description: Whether this asset is a single-doc image or a chunked video.

dataBase64.description: Base64-encoded optimized image payload (empty string for chunked videos).

chunkCount.description: Number of chunks stored in the chunks subcollection (0 for inline images, 1..60 for videos).

size.description: Decoded byte size of the media file (up to 25 MB for videos).

status.description: Explicit active state for public get reads.

createdBy.description: UID of the verified admin who uploaded the media.

MediaChunk.title: MediaChunk
MediaChunk.description: Base64 binary chunk belonging to a durable uploaded video in mediaAssets/{mediaId}/chunks/{chunkId}.

/products/{productId}.description: Publicly readable catalog products managed exclusively by verified admins.

/removedProducts/{productId}.description: Publicly readable removal markers for built-in catalog items, managed exclusively by verified admins.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Publicly readable storefront categories and Home highlight cover images managed exclusively by verified admins.

/heroSlides/{slideId}.description: Publicly readable home hero carousel slides managed exclusively by verified admins.

/mediaAssets/{mediaId}.description: Durable storefront images and chunked video manifests served via /uploads/<filename>.

/mediaAssets/{mediaId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Binary slices for durable uploaded videos; public get by exact chunk ID, admin-only create/delete.

/admins/{uid}.description: Admin role registry readable only by the matching user or bootstrapped admin.
